HOME.HERO_SUBTITLE: Compute your employees' pay directly from their time clock records
HOME.FEATURE_SEARCH_TEXT: Look up an employee by their ID, last name or first name
HOME.FEATURE_POINTAGE_TEXT: The employee's punches are automatically paired into clock-in/clock-out sessions
HOME.FEATURE_CALCUL_TEXT: Enter the hourly rate, the amount is computed from the hours and minutes worked

PAIE.TITLE: Payroll calculation
PAIE.SUBTITLE: Search for one or more employees, choose a period and an hourly rate to compute the amount due
PAIE.CHOOSE_PERIOD_FIRST: Choose a period first (step 1) to see the employees with time records in it.
PAIE.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: ID, last name or first name
PAIE.ALL_EMPLOYEES_HINT: No employee checked: the calculation will run for every employee with a time record for this period.
PAIE.CALCUL_ERROR: An error occurred during the calculation.
PAIE.NO_POINTAGE_IN_PERIOD: None of the selected employees have a time record for the chosen period.
PAIE.INVALID_PERIOD: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
PAIE.FIELD_INVALID_RATE: The rate must be strictly greater than 0.
PAIE.RESULT_ANOMALIES: {{count}} session(s) with a missing clock-out, excluded from the total.
PAIE.RESULT_EMPTY: No time clock records for this period.
PAIE.DETAIL_NOT_FOUND: No result to display for this employee.

POINTAGE.TITLE: Add a time clock record
POINTAGE.SUBTITLE: Search for an employee, then enter the date and time of the punch to record
POINTAGE.NO_EMPLOYEE_SELECTED: Select an employee from the list on the left.
POINTAGE.SAVE_ERROR: An error occurred while adding the record.
